Definition: from G863; freedom; (figuratively) pardon:--deliverance, forgiveness, liberty, remission.
BiblicalUsage: Forgiveness, release — the blood of the covenant shed for the remission of sins, Peter's call to repent and be baptized for the remission of sins, the redemption we have through Christ's blood, and the plain rule that without shedding of blood there is no remission. The word is a release from a debt and a letting go from prison at once.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe forgiveness is the centre of the whole gospel, because it is the one thing I could never do for myself. Christ's blood paid the debt and opened the cell, and I hold that every other blessing in the Christian life flows out of that release.
